scope: Private noncommercial exact-endpoint research, not episode/onset prediction
evaluation: Frozen held-out Stage5 after48h scheduled evaluation; primary clean, secondary input loss scenarios
already_high: Include; classification is of the future endpoint, not a new onset
repeated_flags: Separate five-minute endpoint decisions; no refractory or merging; never interpret origin counts as episode counts
scoring: Only exact finite target at maturity; suppressed forecasts excluded from confusion counts; missing target unscorable; pending not false positive
aggregation: Per participant, macro over defined metrics with contributing counts, and pooled confusion counts; zero denominators null
